primary.title: Nifty soars 2.8% this week: What lies ahead for Dalal Street? - Experts decode 5 triggers, key levels for next week
primary.summary: Indian equities rebounded this week, with the Nifty 2.77%, supported by IT shares and domestic institutional buying. Next week, investors will watch earnings breadth, foreign flows, global rates, crude prices and technical resistance, while experts recommend selective, staggered investing.
